self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: for 10s after the equipping character triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction, their CRIT Rate is increased by 16% and their Stellar Swirl reaction DMG by 40%. Both halves are modelled since 2026-08-09, when Stellar Swirl gained its own reaction key: the 40% uses stellarswirl_dmg_ specifically and must NOT be widened to stellarconduct_dmg_ or the stellarglimmer_dmg_ umbrella — the kit text says Stellar Swirl, so it is narrower than both.
